original_records: The fixed upstream response/source records are downloaded separately. This recipe contains new AI-authored propositions, labels, annotation reasons, offsets and hashes, with no quote/anchor substring fields and no complete context or response. Short factual wording can coincide with upstream strings inside the authored annotations.
coordinate_system: Unicode code-point offsets, end exclusive. Anchor intervals refer to the unchanged original response; evidence intervals refer to unchanged source_info. Prefix length is added only when rebuilding gold answer anchors.
claim_gold_method: Complete response was independently decomposed by AI author; upstream error-span labels were not treated as full claim gold.

original_packet_hashes.input_adapter: Visible original Summary task instruction before unchanged complete response; original offsets stay in original coordinates, gold anchors use adapted coordinates.
original_packet_hashes.review_order: Read only blind.jsonl and this lock. Independently extract all claims, judge S/C/U and cite sufficient literal evidence. Write and hash a locked annotation before reading sealed gold, private origins with upstream labels, author code, statistics or private-cases.
original_packet_hashes.redistribution: Private working input. Public release may contain only fixed IDs, hashes, non-text labels/offsets and deterministic reconstruction script until upstream reuse scope is resolved.

output_privacy: Reconstructed outputs include upstream text and must stay in the private acquisition workspace. This recipe grants no right to redistribute upstream news or responses.
